The '''ME-D''' droids, pronounced '''Meedee''', were specially-designed [[Probe droid/Legends|probe droids]] built by the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Leeha Narezz]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. They were taught Jedi history and philosophy by Leeha in hopes of proving that even droids could use [[The Force/Legends|the Force]].
